basics.name: Ifeanyi Desmond Dike
basics.label: AI Engineer & PhD Applicant
basics.summary: AI engineer and applied mathematician. PhD applicant, Fall 2027. Research focus: conversational AI and speech-language models — turn-taking, multi-speaker dynamics, and evaluation of full-duplex voice AI systems. First Class Honours in Applied Mathematics (GPA 4.63/5.0), four IEEE publications, 8+ years building production AI systems.
